report.notes: New tests: test_r3_01_redirected_head_does_not_move_another_branch_on_restore[other|canon], test_r3_01_reviewer_redirecting_impl_head_is_not_independent, test_r3_02_transient_baseline_gate_failure_is_not_cached, test_r3_03_candidate_moved_after_verified_is_reaudited, test_r3_04_changed_config_blocks_until_owner_acknowledges, test_r3_04_config_binding_is_read_from_the_chain_not_state_json. All 7 fail with c1ba808's lifecycle.py and pass after; the full tests/dev_workflow suite passes (141). R3-01: the repair checks which branch HEAD names before and after; restore re-points HEAD at the candidate branch before reset --hard; that branch is in the review integrity snapshot. R3-02: only COMPLETED_WITH_RESULT baseline results are cached. R3-03: a block resumes at AUDITING when the current candidate has no independent ACCEPT. R3-04: the policy is recorded in PLAN; the config hash is read from the event chain; a CONFIG_CHANGED stops as BLOCKED(CONFIG) until the owner unblocks with that config. The config file stays agent-writable and the owner acknowledgement is the control (documented). graphify was not run: not installed, no graphify-out/.
